files.name: ADAPChromatogramBuilderParameters.java
files.note: The parameter declarations and numeric defaults governing chromatogram construction match; v4.0.8 changes citation/setup-dialog presentation. Minimum absolute height has no safe numeric default and must be set explicitly by the future differential harness.

files.name: ModularADAPChromatogramBuilderModule.java
files.note: The module execution path is otherwise unchanged in the frozen comparison; v4.0.8 renames the displayed module from ADAP Chromatogram Builder to Chromatogram builder.

files.name: ModularADAPChromatogramBuilderTask.java
known_reviewed_differences: candidate sets FeatureShapeType to !isImaging while v4.0.8 only writes true for non-imaging rows
candidate uses FeatureListUtils.sortByDefaultRT while v4.0.8 uses FeatureListUtils.sortByDefault
files.note: Chromatogram seeding, m/z range assignment, continuous-point filtering, zero-edge insertion, and conversion to ModularFeature are unchanged in the audited task body. Output ordering remains a direct-differential question.
